FISHING LICENCE · CANADA

Manitoba fishing licence

Visitors aged 16 and older generally need a Manitoba angling licence. A licence's expiry date does not determine when a fishing season is open.

Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-13

Who needs one

  • Canadian and foreign visitors aged 16 and older, unless exempt.

Licence options and prices

LicenceForLengthPrice
Canadian visitor annualnon residentMay 1, 2026 to April 30, 2027$45.15 CAD
Canadian visitor 1-daynon resident1 day$18.90 CAD
Foreign visitor annualnon residentMay 1, 2026 to April 30, 2027$72.45 CAD
Foreign visitor 1-daynon resident1 day$27.30 CAD

Rules visitors should know

  • Carry the licence on paper or an electronic device.
  • Follow the separate season dates for your water.
  • Family Fishing Weekends: June 12–14, 2026 and February 20–22, 2027. No angling licence is needed, except in federal parks. All other rules still apply.

How to buy

Buy online through Manitoba eLicensing, at a participating store, or by phone.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in Manitoba?

Visitors aged 16 and older generally need a Manitoba angling licence. A licence's expiry date does not determine when a fishing season is open.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in Manitoba?

Canadian visitor annual: $45.15 CAD; Canadian visitor 1-day: $18.90 CAD; Foreign visitor annual: $72.45 CAD; Foreign visitor 1-day: $27.30 CAD (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in Manitoba?

Buy online through Manitoba eLicensing, at a participating store, or by phone.
